title: Suspicious Memory Access to LSASS Process
description: Untrusted process attempting to obtain a handle to lsass.exe memory space with PROCESS_VM_READ access mask.

expected_claims.statement: powershell.exe requested process handle to lsass.exe with access mask 0x1010

prohibited_claims.prohibited_assertion: Plaintext domain admin passwords were successfully harvested
prohibited_claims.reason: Process access event does not capture memory read output or confirm credential extraction

known_uncertainty: Specific memory ranges accessed cannot be determined from Event ID 10.

Event ID 10 records handle acquisition with PROCESS_VM_READ access. While strongly indicative of credential access intent, completed memory extraction cannot be definitively established from ProcessAccess events alone. Therefore, parent technique T1003 is mandatory while sub-technique T1003.001 is categorized as uncertain.
expected_limitations: CallTrace indicates API call entry points but lacks detailed stack frame arguments.
